items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: he brought into the organization in the late '30's... You take a piece from him... and put them together. There again the compiler influence... And that was any amount of that that went on.

ctx.x: Do you remember how long after it was compiled that "Sophisticated Lady" was recorded?

No, not exactly because there were so many, many version and recordings made of it. I think they even made it into a waltz one time. Of course, I think that's when the -- the great Billy Strayhorn had come into the picture.
Uh-huh. Do you remember how long after it was a tune in its own right that it acquired lyrics?
